lewis.name: Lewis
lewis.title: Captain — Corps of Discovery
lewis.bio: Jefferson's private secretary, chosen to lead the expedition west. Botanist, soldier, restless intellect.
lewis.quote: "I shall in future believe myself capable of performing feats both of bodily and mind strength." — Lewis

clark.name: Clark
clark.title: Captain — Co-Commander

abilities.Recruiting: Draws frontier men to the corps

active_ability.name: Chart the Route
active_ability.desc: Next 3 hex moves waive health cost · +4 Morale

clark.bio: Lewis's chosen partner — equal command, not subordinate. Steady hand on the Missouri.
clark.quote: "Ocean in view! O! The joy!" — Clark

york.name: York
york.title: Clark's Manservant — Frontiersman
york.bio: His extraordinary strength and spirit win respect from every nation they encounter. Clark will refuse to grant him freedom after the expedition.
york.quote: "His appearance intimidated and astonished the natives." — Clark

drouillard.name: Drouillard
drouillard.title: Hunter & Sign-Language Interpreter

active_ability.name: Scout Ahead
active_ability.desc: Preview the next random event · +5 Food

drouillard.bio: The finest hunter and scout on the frontier. Half-Shawnee, all woodsman.
drouillard.quote: "He was the best hunter and interpreter in the service." — Lewis

sacagawea.name: Sacagawea
sacagawea.title: Shoshone Guide & Interpreter

active_ability.name: Diplomatic Bridge
active_ability.desc: Boost current tribe to Friendly · +8 Morale

sacagawea.bio: Perhaps sixteen years old and eight months pregnant when she joins the corps. She will prove worth more than any soldier.
sacagawea.quote: "The wife of Charbonneau was of great service as a pilot." — Clark
